import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('benchmark/data.csv')
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
df = df.sort_values('Date').reset_index(drop=True)
prices = df['Crude_Oil_Price'].astype(float)

min_price = prices.min(); max_price = prices.max(); price_range = max_price - min_price

start_price = float(prices.iloc[0]); end_price = float(prices.iloc[-1])
# CAGR based on elapsed years between first and last observation
start_date = df['Date'].iloc[0]; end_date = df['Date'].iloc[-1]
years = (end_date - start_date).days / 365.2425
cagr = (end_price / start_price) ** (1/years) - 1

mom_abs = prices.diff()
mom_pct = prices.pct_change()
idx_abs = mom_abs.abs().idxmax()
max_mom_abs = float(mom_abs.loc[idx_abs])
max_mom_abs_date = df.loc[idx_abs, 'Date']
max_mom_pct = float(mom_pct.loc[idx_abs])
# largest by pct as well
idx_pct = mom_pct.abs().idxmax()
max_mom_pct_val = float(mom_pct.loc[idx_pct])
max_mom_pct_date = df.loc[idx_pct, 'Date']
max_mom_pct_abschange = float(mom_abs.loc[idx_pct])

std = prices.std(ddof=1)

# decade stats
years_series = df['Date'].dt.year
# decade label: 1970s etc
DecadeStart = (years_series//10)*10
# but 2020s includes 2020-2026

df2 = df.copy(); df2['DecadeStart']=DecadeStart
by_decade = df2.groupby('DecadeStart')['Crude_Oil_Price'].agg(['mean','std','min','max','count'])
max_mean_decade = int(by_decade['mean'].idxmax())

# YoY changes: compare to same month previous year
price_yoy_abs = prices - prices.shift(12)
price_yoy_pct = prices / prices.shift(12) - 1
idx_yoy = price_yoy_abs.abs().idxmax()

print('KPI price_range', price_range)
print('CAGR', cagr, 'years', years)
print('Max MoM abs at', max_mom_abs_date.date(), max_mom_abs, 'pct', max_mom_pct)
print('Max MoM pct at', max_mom_pct_date.date(), max_mom_pct_val, 'abs', max_mom_pct_abschange)
print('Decade highest mean', max_mean_decade, by_decade.loc[max_mean_decade,'mean'])
print('Std', std)
print('YoY max abs at', df.loc[idx_yoy,'Date'].date(), float(price_yoy_abs.loc[idx_yoy]), 'pct', float(price_yoy_pct.loc[idx_yoy]))

# distribution
q = prices.quantile([0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.95])
print(q)

# top 10 volatility months by abs MoM pct
rank = mom_pct.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
print('top mom pct')
for i,v in rank.items():
    print(df.loc[i,'Date'].date(), v, mom_abs.loc[i], prices.loc[i-1], prices.loc[i])
